description: Camera and editing grammar for any code-built video (HyperFrames) - ads, launch films, UI walkthroughs, illustrated scenes. 24 moves (pan, tilt, dolly, zoom, tracking, orbit, crane, dolly zoom, rack focus, handheld, FPV, dutch angle, slow motion, speed ramp, time-lapse, freeze frame, jump cut, match cut, whip pan, dissolve, wipe, smash cut, J-cut, L-cut): when to use each, how to stage it on the film's own material, numbers, traps, sound, and working code (camera-kit.js rigs, story time for picture and sound, synthesised move sounds). An executor under video-studio, whose laws still apply. Use when a film needs more than hard cuts, a move is named, or video-studio picks a hook, a transition or a signature moment. Triggers: "camera move", "make a transition", "push in", "dolly zoom", "match cut", "speed ramp", "slow motion", "freeze frame", "whip pan", "how to cut this".
